intro:
Decades ago, the promise of blockchain technology was decentralization, giving power back to the people and shaking off the oppressive yoke of mega-corporations. However, in Alpha City, that promise was twisted and perverted. The corporations seized control of the technology, using it to tighten their grip on the city and its inhabitants. Now, the city is a cyberpunk dystopia, a sprawling metropolis of neon lights, towering skyscrapers, and dark alleys filled with criminals and shadowy figures.

In this city, the players find themselves as a group of rebels, fighting against the oppressive rule of the mega-corporations. They are part of a small underground movement seeking to restore freedom and democracy to Alpha City. As they make their way through the crowded streets and murky back alleys, they can feel the eyes of the corporations watching their every move, and the threat of punishment looms over them like a dark cloud.

The rebellion has gained momentum in recent weeks, with more and more citizens joining the cause. The players have been tasked with a crucial mission: to infiltrate a high-security corporate facility and steal a valuable data chip containing sensitive information that could expose the corruption and brutality of the corporations. The fate of the rebellion and the future of Alpha City itself hangs in the balance, and the players must succeed at all costs. As they stand at the edge of the corporate facility, ready to make their move, they know that the next hour will determine the course of history in Alpha City.
